infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wardrobe uses the camera to photograph your clothes. Photos stay on this device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Wardrobe lets you choose existing photos of your clothes. Photos stay on this device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wardrobe uses the microphone so you can describe an item instead of typing. Recordings are deleted immediately after they are transcribed.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wardrobe uses your location to fetch today's weather forecast, so outfit suggestions match the actual temperature and wind outside.
